exclusions.source_text: Serum creatinine OR Measured or calculated creatinine clearance (GFR can also be used in place of creatinine or CrCl) ≤1.5 X institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) OR ≥60 mL/min for subject with creatinine levels > 1.5 X institutional ULN
exclusions.threshold: creatinine ≤1.5 X ULN or CrCl ≥60 mL/min

exclusions.source_text: AST (SGOT) and ALT (SGPT) ≤ 2.5 X institutional ULN OR ≤ 5 X institutional ULN for subjects with liver metastases
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT ≤ 2.5 X ULN (≤ 5 X ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: Prior CNS disease is allowed if stable for at least one month since whole brain radiation therapy in patients who received whole brain radiation, or 2 weeks since stereotactic radiotherapy in patients who received stereotactic radiotherapy. Patients should not be requiring steroids.

Is pregnant or breastfeeding, or expecting to conceive or father children within the projected duration of the trial, starting with the screening visit through 7 months after the last dose of trial treatment.
Has a known history of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV).
Has known, untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or requires active treatment.
